name: Romazzino
insider_take: Where jet-setters and royalty have retreated since the swinging sixties, this legendary Costa Smeralda hideaway feels like a private estate suspended between emerald hills and crystalline waters.
whats_special: Originally designed by renowned architect Michele Busiri Vici, Romazzino sits on a private bay where the Mediterranean's most exclusive yachts drop anchor. The hotel's signature pink granite facade mirrors the natural rock formations of Sardinia's coastline, while its terraced gardens cascade down to a secluded beach accessible only to guests.
pro_tip: Book the Olivastro Suite for direct beach access and panoramic views of the Maddalena archipelago – it's where Aga Khan himself used to stay during the hotel's early days.
dont_miss: The sunset aperitivo on the Belvedere Terrace overlooking Romazzino Bay, and a day trip to nearby Capriccioli Beach – considered one of Sardinia's most beautiful coves and just a 5-minute walk through fragrant Mediterranean maquis.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on Costa Smeralda with pristine white sand beach
Elegant Mediterranean architecture with panoramic sea views from most rooms
Exceptional dining featuring authentic Sardinian cuisine and fresh seafood
World-class spa treatments and wellness facilities in tranquil setting
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive Porto Cervo location
Seasonal operation with limited availability outside summer months
